messages:
maria_cs: quick notes from today’s onboarding call with Redleaf - dropping raw asks here for triage. main items: 1) per-route token cost export/visibility, 2) per-route fallback pinning (they need route-level overrides), 3) show embedding index version in console metadata.
kevin_onboarding: +1 on per-route cost, this keeps coming up in renewal prep meetings.
anya_support: they want breakdown by model + route + day/week/30/90 window. also want csv export for finance.
sam_product: sounds like two tracks: metrics/export (medium) and routing policy (larger). embedding-version UI seems small.
eva_data: correct - we can do an export MVP using a nightly aggregate table (approx 2 devs + 1 infra week). live dashboard would be extra.
jamie_pm: propose prioritization: 1) export MVP for renewals, 2) embedding-version label shipped quickly, 3) per-route fallback scoped into broader routing epic.
maria_cs: customers reported org-level fallback causes noisy incidents when a product spikes. they're asking for per-route override so different teams can have different SLAs.
sam_product: question: is the ask to set a per-route fallback model, or per-route capacity tier?
kevin_onboarding: per-route fallback model specifically. they want route A -> fallback small-model-A, route B -> fallback small-model-B.
eva_data: effort estimates: export MVP = 3 sprints (data + kpis + export endpoint), embedding-version tag = 2 days (api + UI), per-route fallback = 4-6 sprints (routing layer + tests + rollout).
anya_support: for renewal comms they need a concrete ship window. can we ship export-only as Phase 1?
sam_product: yes - Phase 1 = CSV export + basic aggregates, Phase 2 = console table + filters.
maria_cs: action items: eva will draft data spec, sam writes product brief for export MVP, kevin will pull 3 customer quotes from renewal threads, jamie to add to triage next Tue.
eva_data: will post data spec by EOD tomorrow.
triage-bot: reminder: create JIRA epic CS-EXP-1824 "Per-route cost export MVP".
kevin_onboarding: pls paste sample quote we can include in renewal slides.
maria_cs: pasted (redacted): "finance needs per-route billing to reconcile token spend across products; top-level totals don't explain variance."
sam_product: I'll draft the brief and include rough timelines.
anya_support: I'll run a query for fallback-related errors in the last 30 days and attach logs to the ticket.
jamie_pm: flagging linkage to Q2 reliability OKR - will push for prioritization in planning.
maria_cs: thanks all. I'll message customers with a short note: export MVP targeted for next release, will confirm dates after triage. :thumbsup:
